summary: Crypto markets show selective bullishness with analysts targeting swing longs on ICP, Filecoin, and OP amid a dip, while BTC holds key support near $86,000–$80,000 for potential long entries. Macro sentiment remains cautious as traders await ETH strength to sustain altcoin rallies, with gold and silver also flagged as swing trade opportunities alongside Nvidia.
